brief: A seven-cell honeycomb work surface, covered on top, with every open outside edge finished with caps.

requirements.requirement: Seven hex bases arranged as a honeycomb (one centre cell with six neighbours) forming the work surface.
requirements.evidence: Seven full hex bases placed: centre (0,0,0) plus the six level-0 neighbours (-1,0),(-1,1),(0,-1),(0,1),(1,-1),(1,0).

requirements.requirement: The work surface is covered on top (cover plates on the top faces of the bases).
requirements.evidence: Seven full top covers added, one on each base's top face (cover family, face top).

requirements.requirement: Every open outside edge of the honeycomb is finished with a cap.
requirements.evidence: Eighteen caps added (6 outer cells x 3 open outside faces each), the caps placed on the exposed edges of the outer ring. Shared inner faces left unfinished, as they are internal.

requirements.requirement: No open-cap-face issue (every exposed edge capped).
requirements.evidence: check_build returned no OPEN_CAP_FACE issue; meshClash clear. Only remaining warning is LOOSE_BODY (pieces could slide apart; joint bolts would lock them), which the brief does not ask for and I did not add.

finish.summary: Built a seven-cell honeycomb work surface: seven full hex bases (centre plus six neighbours), a top cover on every base, and 18 caps on the open outside edges of the outer ring. check_build reports meshClash clear and no open-cap-face issue. It warns that the pieces could slide apart without joint bolts; I left those out since the brief did not mention them.
